newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK HERACLES CEMENT CLEARED FOR BOND ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK HERACLES CEMENT CLEARED FOR BOND ISSUE.

text.p: Greek cement producer Heracles Cement got shareholder approval for a 18 billion drachma bond issue at Tuesday's annual general meeting.
The bond loan will be taken up by National Bank , Commercial Bank and Midland Bank-Athens, sources said.
Shares of Heracles Cement shall trade ex-dividend May 21 after declaring a 100 drachma dividend for fiscal 1996, up from 80 drachmas in the previous year.
Its profit increased 31 percent to 12.1 billion drachmas in fiscal 1996 on turnover growth of 10.6 percent to 92.9 billion drachmas.

Earnings growth was restrained by 2.0 billion drachma provisions, posted following the acquisition of a 51 percent stake in affiliated Halkis Cement, a loss-making Greek cement producer, in November 1996.
Consolidated earnings were up 6.4 percent to 13.3 billion drachmas in 1996. Turnover rose 12.1 percent to 111.7 billion drachmas.
Heracles Cement shares were off 450 drachmas to 5,350 on Tuesday on volume of 96,070 shares. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
